source: Rounded working estimates for planning only. Cambridge sets grade thresholds per session, AFTER the exam, and they move with the difficulty of that paper. Replace with data/grades/as_thresholds.json holding the published thresholds for your session (Cambridge publishes them on results day; schools receive them through the School Support Hub) and set provenance to 'published'.
note: Cambridge International AS Level is graded a to e. There is no A* at AS Level — A* is awarded on the full A Level aggregate only.
